role: Defines the EmailContact value (name/email/notes) and EmailContactStore, the @Observable @MainActor singleton address book persisted as email_contacts.json in Application Support, used by the AI's assistant.email.compose / contacts.add / contacts.remove actions and the Settings email-contacts section.
types: EmailContact: struct — Codable/Identifiable/Hashable contact record (id, name, email, notes, createdAt)
EmailContactStore: class (@Observable @MainActor) — in-memory contact list + JSON file persistence via LatestWinsFileWriter, name→address resolution
state: mem:EmailContactStore.shared (static singleton; returned by AppDependencies.app.emailContactStore unless overridden)
mem:EmailContactStore.contacts (@Observable, private(set)) read by SettingsView+Pages EmailContactsSection and AppFactResolver+AssistantEmail

file:<ApplicationSupport>/email_contacts.json (falls back to <tmp>/email_contacts.json when Application Support cannot be resolved), written atomic with .completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication
toplevel: `static let shared = EmailContactStore()` lazily creates the singleton on first access, whose init reads email_contacts.json. EmailContact gets synthesized Codable/Equatable/Hashable.

flags.text: When Application Support cannot be resolved the store silently uses the temporary directory, so contacts written there are lost when iOS purges tmp; only a warning log from attempt() records it.

units.does: Memberwise initializer for EmailContact: stores id (default new UUID), name, email, notes (default nil) and createdAt (default now).

Delete-All-My-Data hook: empties the in-memory contacts, clears loadFailed, and calls the writer's discard(), which drops any pending write, waits out an in-flight write and deletes email_contacts.json if it exists.

Initializer: uses the injected storeURL, or <ApplicationSupport>/email_contacts.json (creating the directory; tmp dir fallback), builds a LatestWinsFileWriter (atomic, completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication, label emailContacts) and synchronously loads the file.

branches.effect: true: use it; false: resolve Application Support path

branches.cond: ?? — Application Support URL lookup threw (attempt returned nil)
branches.effect: falls back to FileManager.temporaryDirectory; contacts then live in tmp

units.does: Appends a contact (after re-reading the file if the last load failed) and enqueues a save of the full list.
Edits name/email/notes of the contact with the given id (only supplied fields change; empty notes becomes nil), then saves. Unknown id returns without saving.

branches.effect: early return, nothing saved; otherwise idx is used
set notes (nil when empty); else keep
true: store nil; false: store the text

flags.text: No caller anywhere in the repo (app or tests) calls EmailContactStore.update(id:...); the Settings UI only adds/deletes and the AI only adds/removes, so a contact cannot be edited.

units.does: Removes every contact with the given id (after a blocked-load retry) and saves.
Returns all contacts whose name equals the whitespace-trimmed argument case-insensitively.
Splits a comma-separated list, trims and drops empty entries, classifies each as resolved address / unknown / ambiguous and returns the three lists.
Classifies one name: any string containing both '@' and '.' passes through as an address; otherwise looks it up by name — 0 matches unknown, >1 ambiguous, 1 resolved to that contact's email.

branches.effect: returned as-is as a resolved address without any further validation
return .ambiguous; else resolved to the single match's email

flags.text: Address detection is just contains('@') && contains('.'), so a name like 'j.smith@' passes through unvalidated as a recipient address.

units.does: If email_contacts.json exists, reads and JSON-decodes it into contacts and clears loadFailed; on any read/decode error sets loadFailed (blocking saves) and logs an error. Missing file leaves contacts as-is.

branches.effect: return; contacts unchanged (empty on first launch)
loadFailed=true, error logged at .error, contacts keep previous (empty) value; subsequent saves are refused until a reload succeeds

units.does: Re-runs load() before an edit when the previous load failed.

branches.effect: true: reload from disk (replaces in-memory list); false: no-op

units.does: Enqueues the current contact list on the latest-wins writer unless the last load failed.

branches.effect: true: log error and return without writing — the edit stays only in memory and is lost at relaunch (or overwritten by the next successful reload); false: enqueue write

flags.text: When the file is unreadable, add/remove still mutate the in-memory list and the UI shows the change, but save() refuses to persist and retryLoadIfBlocked on the next edit replaces the list from disk, discarding earlier unsaved edits; the user is told nothing.
